title: 第三章 吞噬梦魔融合梦境第四章 梦境坍塌奇点维度
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
“嘿嘿！”
在见到恐惧梦魔如今的样子之后，陆羽不由嘿嘿一笑。
随后，陆羽活动了一下手腕，看着那一方恐惧梦魔所在的梦境，直接一步踏出，便是进入了那方梦境所在。
似乎是发现了陆羽的存在，那本来一直卷缩着的恐惧梦魔虚影，终于是迅速的舒展开来，快速蠕动着，向着陆羽的方向蔓延而来。
一股股的恐惧力量扩散，恐惧梦魔不断蠕动变幻着形象，并且全都带着一抹深邃恐怖的黑色。
那是一种极致深邃的黑，让人一眼看上去，便就浑身发凉，心生恐惧的那种。
那头恐惧梦魔，似乎想要通过这种方式，带给陆羽极致的恐惧，让他在极度的恐惧之中绝望死去。
不过，作为同样掌握了恐惧力量的陆羽，却并没有受到影响，反而同样散发出了一股恐惧力量，将恐惧梦魔的力量给抵消，甚至反向压制过去。
“叽！
@！
%“@*”
恐惧梦魔身形停下，发出一连串的古怪声音，带着一股摄人心神的恐惧力量波动。
很显然，眼前的这头恐惧梦魔，十分地好奇眼前人类，为什么会拥有与他相同的力量？...
“诶~？”
看着眼前的恐惧梦魔，陆羽也是微微愕然。
根据刚才脑海之中的信息，眼前的恐惧梦魔，似乎只是一头最低级的梦魔，只有一些散发恐惧，吞噬恐惧力量的本能而已。
怎么现在看它这样，好像产生了一些灵智似的？...
这难道是受了什么刺激，所以诞生了灵智不成？
总不会是因为我这不断戏耍，不断对其进行攻击造成的吧？
“呃...”

陆羽摸了摸鼻子，他是绝对不会承认，眼前这头恐惧梦魔，是因为自己对其造成的刺激，才让其觉醒灵智的。
嗯，不管其绝没觉醒灵智，他反正都是死定了。
陆羽抬手下压，无边的梦境力量汇聚，尽数拢罩在恐惧梦魔的身上，恐惧的力量激荡，那恐惧梦魔的身体，竟然微微抖动了一下。
同时，一丝微不可查的力量，融入了陆羽的体内。
“呃，这样也可以吗？”
感受着体内力量的增加，陆羽微微一愣，没想到这恐惧梦魔，也会有着恐惧情感。
他原先还以为，这什么制造恐惧，获得恐惧力量的反馈，需要对人使用呢，没想到这些梦魔也可以。
唔，也是，眼前这头恐惧梦魔，毕竟已经觉醒了灵智，会产生恐惧的感觉，倒也不是不可以理解。
看来，哪怕是同样的力量，也并不能完全免疫同种力量的震慑啊，这恐怕就只能看，是哪一方掌控的力量更强了。
而现在，很显然就是陆羽掌控的力量更强了。
既然如此...
陆羽立即加大了力量的输出，同时还以掌控的梦境力量，具现出了一柄大刀。
嗯，四十米的大刀见过没？...
现在有了！
“唰！”
恐惧之力加持的大刀落下，凛冽的刀光照耀天地，那一头恐惧梦魔虚影，似乎受到了极致的惊吓，整个身体都是剧烈扭曲起来。
“呜~！”
一股股的恐惧力量，不断涌入陆羽体内，甚至让他情不自禁的呻吟出声。
“嗤~！”
content_en:
"Hey!"
After seeing what the terrifying dream demon looked like now, Lu Yu couldn't help but smile.
Then, Lu Yu moved his wrist, looked at the dreamland where the fearful dream demon was, and stepped directly into the dreamland.
As if Lu Yu's existence had been discovered, the fearful dream demon figure that had been curled up finally quickly unfolded, squirming quickly, and spread towards Lu Yu's direction.
Waves of fear power spread, and the fear nightmare kept squirming and changing its image, and all of them had a deep and terrifying black color.
It was an extremely deep black, the kind that would make people feel cold and fearful at the first glance.
The fearful dream demon seemed to want to use this method to bring extreme fear to Lu Yu, causing him to die of despair in extreme fear.
However, Lu Yu, who also mastered the power of fear, was not affected. Instead, he also exuded a power of fear, which offset the power of the fearful dream demon and even suppressed it in reverse.
“Ji!
@!
%"@*"
The terrifying dream demon stopped and made a series of strange sounds, carrying a wave of fearful power that gripped the mind.
Obviously, the fearful dream demon in front of him is very curious about why the human in front of him has the same power as him. ...
"Eh~? "
Looking at the fearful dream demon in front of him, Lu Yu was also slightly stunned.
According to the information in my mind just now, the fearful dream demon in front of me seems to be just the lowest level dream demon, with only some instincts to exude fear and devour the power of fear.
Why does it look like this now, as if it has some intelligence? ...
Could it be that he was stimulated by something, so he was born with spiritual intelligence?
It couldn't be caused by my constant teasing and attacking, right?
"Uh..."
Lu Yu touched his nose. He would never admit that the fearful dream demon in front of him awakened his intelligence because of the stimulation he caused to it.
Well, regardless of whether he has never awakened his spiritual intelligence, he is dead anyway.
Lu Yu raised his hand and pressed down, and the boundless power of the dream gathered around the body of the fearful dream demon. The power of fear stirred up, and the body of the fearful dream demon actually shook slightly.
At the same time, a trace of undetectable power was integrated into Lu Yu's body.
"Uh, is this okay? "
Feeling the increase in power within his body, Lu Yu was slightly startled. He did not expect that this fearful dream demon would also have the emotion of fear.
He originally thought that to create fear and obtain feedback from the power of fear, he needed to use it on people, but he didn't expect that these dream demons could do it too.
Well, that's right. After all, the fearful dream demon in front of him has awakened his spiritual intelligence, so it's not incomprehensible that he would feel fear.
It seems that even the same power is not completely immune to the shock of the same power. I am afraid it just depends on which party controls the stronger power.
But now, it is obvious that Lu Yu has stronger control.
In this case...
Lu Yu immediately increased his power output, and at the same time, he used the dream power he controlled to manifest a big sword.
Well, have you ever seen a forty-meter sword? ...
Now there is!
"Ugh! "
The big knife blessed by the power of fear fell, and the cold sword light illuminated the world. The phantom of the fearful dream demon seemed to be extremely frightened, and the whole body was violently twisted.
"Woo~! "
Wave after wave of fearful power continued to pour into Lu Yu's body, even making him moan uncontrollably.
"Tsk~! "
